_about: Cut-offs for grading each ski day. Evidence and sources: claude/snow-quality-research-2026-11-16.md in the Travel program project. Snow amounts are the model's daily snow water scaled per resort so the window average matches calib.csv.

_notes.rain_day_mm: rain of 1 mm or more in the day wets the surface (and makes that day Slushy)
_notes.melt_hours: melting (wets the surface): 3+ daytime hours (09:00-17:59) above +1 C AND a day maximum of +2 C or more (melt_max_c). Before 17 Nov: 2+ hours above +0.5 C.
_notes.refreeze_c: overnight low (00:00-08:59) that refreezes a wet surface into a crust
_notes.icy_days: a crust counts as Icy on the morning it forms and the next day; after that grooming has usually broken it up (Packed)
_notes.cover_cm: new snow that buries a crust; also, a day with this much new snow is not a wetting day and not Slushy because of rain
_notes.powder: 15 cm+ in 24 h or 25 cm+ in 48 h with no wetting since, falling at -3 C or colder (snow-weighted); otherwise Good. Wind is not used: the model's 10 m gusts on snowy days are mostly 80-190 km/h in mountain grid cells (median about 100 km/h at Les 3 Vallees mid-mountain), so they cannot tell wind-packed snow from sheltered snow (16 Nov 2026).
_notes.good: 5 cm+ in the last 3 days with no wetting since
_notes.slushy_hours: Slushy: 3+ daytime hours above +1 C AND a day maximum of +3 C or more (slushy_max_c); or rain of 1 mm+ with under 10 cm of new snow that day.
_notes.icysoft: a refrozen morning that softens by afternoon
_notes.default_points: Owner, 16 Nov 2026: a powder day counts the same as a good snow day, and snow density (light or heavy) matters little as long as snow is regular. So Powder = Good = 80; the -3 C density rule now only labels days, it does not change scores.
_notes.hardpack: Icy, no new snow 14+ days (key 'hardpack'): a day that would be Packed, but more than 14 days since the last snowfall of 5 cm+. Added 17 Nov 2026: Yabuli (56% of days) and Beidahu (66%) never thaw, so they graded as Packed and Yabuli ranked above Hotham. Nathan, 17 Nov: 'Yabuli was horrible', 'Yabuli was like icy. Felt worse than hard pack'. Scored 0, the same as Icy. Elsewhere it affects 8% of days or fewer.
_notes.rain_as_snow_max_c: Model rain on a day whose maximum at this height is +1.5 C or lower counts as snow. The model decides rain or snow at its own grid height; at Hotham it runs about 1 C warm in the afternoons against the Bureau's station (July mean max -0.1 C).
_notes.calibration_17nov: Rules checked 17 Nov 2026 against Nathan's week at Hotham, 17-24 July 2024 ('almost perfect'; resort reports: 26 cm on 15-16 July, bluebird 18 July, 31 cm in 24 h to 20 July, about 60 cm for the week, cold snow, sunny 24 July). Old rules graded it Slushy/Icy (week 33); new rules: Good, Good, Good, Powder, Powder, Good, Packed, Packed (week 73).
